package.name: cbr1_data_pipeline
package.description: Research data pipeline for CBR-1: records rosbag2 experiments with reproducibility metadata (operator, timestamp, code commit, free-text notes) and exports topics to CSV for offline analysis. Works against any robot bringup (real or simulated) since it only depends on standard ROS 2 topics, not CBR-1's (still undecided) hardware specifics.
